node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport first to (P_R,P_U,P_V) and then to (P_R,P_V,P_U), using the hypotheses established above. Together with the two ambient zero dimensions, this gives dim S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_V^R}=0 and dim S^{A_R}_{P_V^R,P_U^R}=0. Hence all four dimension equalities asserted by node 1 hold with the universal e_zero chosen above.
